verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents templates as the way to set up a rented machine with whatever software you need, with "Build a template" to package your environment and one-click launch of prebuilt or custom templates. Its docs also cover the Docker image config editor (custom docker run/create options, overridable entrypoint), and a community report confirms renters can deploy their own images. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of pulling arbitrary or private-registry images (including registry auth), and stronger hands-on corroboration of custom-image workflows.
